search_surface: Bounded format-specific comparison of the four named C++ XML parser libraries (tinyxml2, pugixml, Xerces-C++, libxml++) on Debian popcon dev-package installs, with Homebrew install-on-request (365d) as a second numeric metric. RapidXML (Debian librapidxml-dev) was added from the same snapshots after a scoped candidate passed verification. Whole frameworks (Qt, Boost, POCO) are not ranked.

debian_dev_package_search.method: Binary-package names in the same hashed by_inst table matched by the case-insensitive pattern (xml|xerces|tinyxml|arabica|studxml|expat|sax|markup) plus targeted C++ XML library names (cxxtools, xalan, xqilla, xsdcxx, gdome2-cpp, gsoap, boost, qt6-base, poco); every C++ XML -dev or framework package seen is listed with its decision. Limit: the first 100 'xml' name hits by installations (shared with the C cell's binary search) and the targeted names; not every C++ library is covered.
